debris_cy.method: FEMA 329: destroyed homes L x W x stories x 0.20 x VM (1.1-1.5); manufactured homes 290 or 415 CY; flood events add 25-30 CY per home at Major. No FEMA coefficient exists for other levels, so they add nothing.

building_loss_usd.note: Structure plus contents value from USACE NSI where matched; buildings without a matched value are left out, so the range is low by their share.
